defaultCap.description: Default per player spawn cap limit when not explicitly set in playerCaps

playerCaps.description: The maximum number of mobs around each palyer per spawn category.

range.description: Options about the spawn range of mobs around each player

spawnDelay.description: The delay between each spawning-task run

runTimes.description: How often should each spawn category, attempt spawns. The higher a value, the more time between spawn attempts.

maxSpawnAttemptsPerPlayer.description: How many times to try and find a valid spawn position around a player before giving up.

playerCapRadius.description: Radius around the player to count mob categories for spawn caps.

defaultNearbyRange.description: Radius to count nearby mobs for the maxNearby condition.
